goal: Secure a $3.0M FY27 program increase to an aggregated Procurement, Defense-Wide soldier-systems line (P-1 Line 68) for visual augmentation optics through a sponsored House floor amendment to the FY27 Defense Appropriations Act, with Senate entry and conference in parallel and the FY28 programmatic request window as the backstop.

clientContextFixture.profileSummary: Small electro-optics manufacturer with a fielded SOF optic on an existing USSOCOM IDIQ; a member office has agreed to carry the request; the House Appropriations Committee reported the FY27 defense bill on July 10, 2026 and the floor schedule is not yet announced; the FY27 NDAA has already passed the House, closing that amendment window.

nodes.subject: optics
nodes.title: Request reads as a directed buy rather than a capability quantity

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Confirm the Line 68 and P-40a sub-line baseline from the FY27 procurement justification book

nodes.subject: ask
nodes.title: Client input required: performing company, optic configuration, quantity, and unit cost

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Draft the requirement statement and quantity-and-cost sheet for the $3.0M increase

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Offset analysis: screen candidate Procurement and RDT&E Defense-Wide lines with two alternatives

nodes.subject: ask
nodes.title: Offset identified and screened with the sponsor office

nodes.subject: member
nodes.title: Sponsor office initiates the House Legislative Counsel amendment draft

nodes.subject: deliverable
nodes.title: Amendment text, offset, and one-page justification are filing-ready

nodes.subject: agency
nodes.title: Validate the requirement and executability with the program office

nodes.subject: committee
nodes.title: Preview the amendment and offset with HAC-D majority and minority staff

nodes.subject: submission
nodes.title: File the floor amendment to the FY27 Defense Appropriations Act when the Rules Committee window opens

nodes.subject: outcome
nodes.title: FY27 inclusion in the year-end agreement, or a written FY28 submission commitment

orderingAssertions.description: the offset is identified before the amendment is filed
the package is filing-ready before staff preview begins

notes: Procurement plus-up via floor amendment: exercises the amendment-specific verifier checks (a vehicle-named submission n11 gated on the offset gate n6), a client-input decision node (n3), an unscheduled Rules Committee window modelled as a decision (n12), and the conference/FY28 backstop (n13, n14). congress is [] because the committee markup already happened before the plan starts and the floor window is not scheduled.
